head: 5e1a01066b9eef0eb3c478e8b49e15e1da15b0b9
scope: Baseline measured residuals and unclosed limits; no candidate replays or global parity certification. Encoding ownership expanded after initial audit; no language audit gate is silently promoted.

obligations.title: Figure explicit none retains lexical caption presence
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Omitted caption is absent; explicit caption:none is known and exposes none through fields/has/at.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned model/figure.rs:195–205 declares optional caption; foundations/content/mod.rs:538–591 defines known-field access. Oracle explicitly distinguishes omission from none.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Figure caption Option collapses omission and explicit none. Enumerating existing Some caption repairs only present-content cases; this batch has no new public presence carrier approval.
obligations.concrete_refuter: Repeat figure-none after a presence-owner correction: fields includes caption:null, has(caption)=true, at(caption)=none, while figure-omitted remains absent.

obligations.title: Artifact kind omitted versus explicit other
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Omitted kind is unknown at raw construction; explicit other/layout and other accepted kinds are Set and enumerated before body.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned model/accessibility.rs ArtifactElem kind declaration and foundations/content/mod.rs known-field contract; local compiler/stdlib/pdf.rs:331 collapses omission to Other.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Existing ArtifactKind payload cannot distinguish omitted from explicit other. Universal enumeration invents omitted presence; non-Other-only enumeration still leaves explicitOther unresolved.
obligations.concrete_refuter: Bilateral omitted/other/layout probes distinguish has/fields/at including omitted unset error; exercise all twelve accepted kind names without manufacturing defaults.

obligations.title: Equation omitted block and unset diagnostic
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Raw constructor omission does not mark block Set; declared omitted equation options produce the unknown-at-this-point diagnostic rather than a nonexistent-field diagnosis.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned math/equation.rs:59–64 gives block default; foundations/content/mod.rs:538–573 separates has and at. Constructor field presence remains distinct from resolved default.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Current EquationElem block is a bool without lexical presence transport. Correct native callback identity and marked style projection do not repair absent block provenance or all declared-field diagnostic classification.
obligations.concrete_refuter: math.equation[x].has("block") false when omitted and true for block:false; fields omit only the former; at("block") and at("numbering") without a default use the pinned unset diagnostic; bogus remains undeclared.

obligations.title: Ordinary Styled strict child/styles reflection
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Ordinary Styled preserves its own child/styles fields and remains opaque to Equation child fields; CLI serialization already exposes that schema.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned foundations/content/mod.rs:759–768 declares child/styles required; :584–591 enumerates known fields.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Marker correction protects outer opacity but does not itself add ordinary Styled strict getter/schema representation. CLI child/styles success does not certify fields()/has()/at().
obligations.concrete_refuter: For text(fill:red)[x], fields exposes child/styles and matching has/at; body/text remain absent. For text(fill:red,equation(...)), do not expose Equation options as Styled fields.

obligations.title: Legacy serializer rich fields remain incomplete
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Public content serialization represents known source fields, preserving lexical absence rather than reconstructing arbitrary defaults; specialized owner promises remain binding.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned foundations/content/mod.rs:710–719 serializes func plus fields. Current shell L0 bounds legacy projection and explicitly excludes universal fields parity.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Spelling out exhaustive residual decisions does not add missing width/transform/kind data or remove legacy Heading/Equation synthesized defaults. Box strict body is explicitly excluded until presence transport; this limitation must remain visible.
obligations.concrete_refuter: Re-run named source JSON/YAML cases against pinned oracle after their owning contracts are audited; assert missing known properties and absent defaults individually; preserve Some(empty)/Some(known) snapshots and Box omitted-body distinction.

obligations.title: Horizontal spacing public function name
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: h constructor reflection uses public function identity/name h while preserving amount and explicit weak presence.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned content func contract foundations/content/mod.rs:530–535; source h constructor public declaration under layout/spacing.rs, corroborated by both source probes.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Fields/has/at agree in these cases but product func repr is hspace. Equation native repair does not authorize a broad callable catalogue/name rewrite.
obligations.concrete_refuter: h(1pt).func() repr and callable/native identity agree with h, aliases preserve native identity, homonymous closures do not; omitted/explicit weak remains unchanged.

obligations.title: Caption query selection precedes serializer
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: A realized figure caption is discoverable by its locatable native selector and yields its body in query.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned model/figure.rs:510–519 marks FigureCaption Locatable. Oracle source document returns one caption while product query returns none.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: The shell cannot serialize an occurrence absent from selection/indexing. Caption raw-field repair and explicit fallback classification do not create the missing occurrence.
obligations.concrete_refuter: Same figure document query figure.caption returns the caption; --field body returns Cap in JSON/YAML; preserve count, query order, effects, and occurrence identity.

obligations.title: Outer Styled representation remains distinct from equation repr
obligations.status: open; baseline measured; no candidate closure
obligations.intended_language_behavior: Ordinary external style wrappers remain visible in language repr rather than being erased into constructor repr.
obligations.intent_source: Pinned StyledElem Repr declaration foundations/content/mod.rs:759–768; local eval/repr/content.rs:554–620 strips Styled after inspecting equation options.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: The identity/strict fields/textual encoding scope does not change public repr owner. Direct constructor repr success does not certify outer-style repr.
obligations.concrete_refuter: repr(text(fill:red,math.equation(numbering:none)[x])) retains styled(child: equation(...), ..) as pinned; no private marker appears, and direct constructor repr remains equation.

obligations.title: Marker effect on general style equality is not certified
obligations.status: unknown beyond bounded positive; not closed and not asserted a measured defect
obligations.intended_language_behavior: An internal constructor-provenance marker must not alter language equality of observably equal content.
obligations.intent_source: ADR-0107 distinguishes morphology from mechanics; local eval/observation/style.rs:59 compares custom payloads, while Styles Rust Debug is internal mechanics unless an observable path is demonstrated.
obligations.why_not_closed_by_current_scope: Only same-source equality was measured and returned true in both. This neither proves a general equality defect nor certifies aliases/reconstruction/merged style behavior after insertion of a private marker.
obligations.concrete_refuter: Add independent alias-versus-reconstruction and outer-style equal/unequal controls at source level and exact marker-only transport tests at the owner boundary; candidate results must establish language outcomes, not mere Rust PartialEq.
